data.title: 2B · 露背黑裙靠柱私密自抚情愫
data.description: 【2B · 露背黑裙靠柱私密自抚情愫】水没都市残存的高耸大理石断柱背光阴影下，海浪在脚下轻轻回响。2B 身穿露背黑色晚礼服，裙摆被轻提至大腿上方。她单臂环抱轻托着自己沉甸甸的玉乳，另一只戴着黑色丝绸长手套的指尖轻柔探入湿润花径。白皙细指在花褶间缓缓摸索，唇瓣微张溢出轻柔微喘——「哈啊……这种数据异常……即使执行全量自检……也无法消除……」
data.location: 水没都市断柱背风隐蔽处
data.action: 背靠大理石柱提裙轻抚自身，单手揉乳，黑丝手套手指深入私处自我探索，微喘低语
data.lighting: 夕阳斜晖打在海面折射的粼粼金光与柱体阴影深处的私密
data.camera: medium shot, focus on flushed expression, mole under mouth, and lifted gown
data.promptProse: Reflected sky surrounds adult 2B leaning alone against a marble pillar in flooded city ruins. Her black evening gown is open beneath bare breasts and gathered above one bent thigh, while shallow water reaches her ankles. One gloved hand supports her chest and the other fingers herself beneath the lifted skirt, sending ripples through white petals. Short white hair and black blindfold frame parted lips, damp skin and quiet wonder. Vertical environmental solo portrait, no text or extra people.
